method: Read each runtime workspace actual tsconfig.build.json and resolve its compiler options/include/exclude/extends. In-memory transpileModule each included non-declaration TypeScript source; use TypeScript getOutputFileNames for output mapping. Compare existing emitted JS after source-map footer, line-ending and trailing-whitespace normalization. Also require equality without per-line trailing-whitespace normalization. No compiler build, typecheck or runtime test is executed. Every source/manifest/read tracked compiler config byte is checked against the pinned Git blob; source/config/dist bytes are rechecked unchanged after comparison.

normalization.historicalComparator: CRLF/CR to LF; remove sourceMappingURL footer lines; remove per-line trailing spaces/tabs; trim file end.
normalization.additionalStricterControl: CRLF/CR to LF; remove sourceMappingURL footer lines; trim file end; retain per-line trailing spaces/tabs.

qualificationLimits: This proves current included emitted JavaScript matches in-memory TypeScript emission under the current build configs, subject to disclosed normalization. It is not a semantic TypeScript check or build execution.
Declaration files and source-map content are outside this comparison.
External dependency identity, application bundling, coverage, browser and release gates are outside this check.
The older build-input-review.json remains historical and untouched.
